about: Where things sit on the table of the mod '7 Wonders Duel [ULTIMATE ed.]' (Workshop 3368311210), in TTS world units (x to the right as the players see it, z away from them). Measured from the Age II save docs/research/tts-mod/ml-practice.json and the mod's own setup scripts (Age I/II/III deal positions, Deal Wonders, Great Library and Progress token buttons). Red sits left (x < 0), White right. Rectangles are x1..x2 by z1..z2. The table snapshot (snapshot.lua) reports raw positions; TableView turns them into places with this file.

pyramid.about: Slot centres: x = xStep * (column - centre column of that Age's layout), z = zTop - zStep * row (layout columns are in half-card units, data/base/layouts.json). Same in all three Ages (mod scripts: Age I/II rows z 10..0, Age III z 10..-5). Covering cards lie higher (y).

wonders.about: Wonder cards stand in a column per player; rows 1..4 run from the board outwards (the mod's leftPlayerWonder1..4 zones). A built Wonder has its Age card tucked face down about 3 units inwards on the same row.

offers.about: The Deal Wonders button lays the 4 offered Wonders face up here (each of the two draft rounds).

libraryDraw.about: The Great Library button deals the 3 drawn tokens face up at z = -24, x = -/+12, 8, 4. snapshot.lua never names a token here (the draw is private).

sides.about: Each player's own area, for taken Progress tokens and coins.

table.about: The playing area. Pieces outside it (the box area on the left: undealt and removed decks, unused Wonders, promo Wonders at x = -76.7) are storage, never game input.

track.about: Conflict Pawn space = round((x - centre) / step), positive towards White's capital. Approximate (fitted to the mod's 2/5/10 VP zones); a soft check only (spec A12).

military.about: Home spots of the 4 looting tokens; a token is still on the board when one with the same value lies within snap of its home. 'side' is the player who loses the coins.

pantheon.about: Pantheon pieces (spec-pantheon P-A9), placed only in Pantheon games. Computed from the mod file (tts/fixtures/pantheon-pieces.json): the Global script spawns the Pantheon board at the battle track + (0.08, 6.49), scale 5.463, turned 180 degrees, and its 6 snap points (scaled, turned) are the spaces, listed left to right (Red's end first); the area is the Divinity area trigger it spawns (the Age II button counts the 6 cards in it). Activated Divinities lie on each player's Divinity board, inside the mod's pantheonDivinityLeft/Right zones (what its Score button counts), below the player's area. A stolen Wonder (Ra) goes in a 5th row above row 1 (the mod's pantheonLeft/RightRaWonder zones). Mythology and Offering tokens on the structure lie about 0.9 above their card's centre (the mod's Age I and II setup scripts). Minerva stands on the Military track. To be confirmed at the live table (docs/tts-live-checks.md).
